title: Smart Data Models - Gaia-X Ontology - InstantiationRequirement
description: https://w3id.org/gaia-x/2.1.11#class/InstantiationRequirement. A container class to gather all requirements for compute service offering instantiations. Subclass of GaiaXEntity per the Gaia-X ontology; declares no own properties (abstract, parent to ComputeFunctionConfiguration, ServerFlavor, ConnectivityConfiguration, ContainerResourceLimits, and StorageConfiguration); inherited properties are documented on the GaiaXEntity model and not repeated here.

id.description: Property. Unique identifier of the entity

type.description: Property. NGSI-LD Entity type. It must be equal to 'InstantiationRequirement'

dateModified.description: Property. Model:'https://schema.org/DateTime'. Timestamp of the last modification.

source.description: Property. A sequence of characters giving the source of the entity data.

dataProvider.description: Property. A sequence of characters identifying the provider of the harmonised data entity.
